title: Retention: add change history + tenant export endpoint (for compliance report pack)
author: Kevin Osei
release_notes: Adds retention policy change history and a customer-admin export endpoint used by the Compliance Reporting Pack generator (MVP). Export includes effective policy + defaults + change log summary and is scoped/authorized for enterprise evidence workflows.
body: Context: The Compliance Reporting Pack MVP needs a deterministic, customer-ready artifact that captures (a) the tenant’s effective retention settings across supported data classes and (b) the auditability of retention changes over time. Today we can fetch the current policy, but we don’t retain a first-class change history nor provide a stable export payload suitable for report generation. This PR adds: (1) retention policy change history persisted in the control plane with immutability guarantees, and (2) a new export endpoint that produces a versioned export (JSON) used by the report pack generator and audit-log-exporter attachment bundling. Scope: control plane only; does not change TTL enforcement in data plane stores. What’s included: 1) Change history: new table retention_policy_change_events with append-only rows capturing actor, source, diff summary, previous_policy_hash, new_policy_hash, request_id, and effective_at. History is written on every successful policy create/update/patch as part of the same transaction as the policy write. Includes backfill for existing tenants: we create a single seed event “imported_current_state” with actor=system and previous hash=null. 2) Export endpoint: GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/retention/export?format=json&include=history_summary&window_days=90. This returns the tenant’s effective retention config (post-validation, post-defaulting, post-tier constraints) plus an optional bounded history summary. The response is versioned via export_schema_version and is intended to be stable for external evidence packages (see ADR-018). 3) Authorization/RBAC: export requires role=SecurityAdmin or ComplianceAuditor (new permission RETENTION_EXPORT_READ). Endpoint is tenant-scoped; cross-tenant access is blocked at the router layer + DB query layer. All exports emit an audit log event retention.exported with tenant_id, actor_id, and export_schema_version (no policy contents logged). 4) Redaction: Export payload intentionally excludes free-form notes fields and internal-only evaluator debug fields. Actor email is replaced with actor_display_name + actor_type + actor_id. 5) Rate limiting + caching: export response supports If-None-Match via an ETag computed from (effective_policy_hash + latest_change_event_id + query params) to reduce repeated generation during report pack assembly. 6) Tests: unit tests for diff summarization and hash stability; integration tests for RBAC and ETag behavior; snapshot test for export v1.0 payload shape. API details: Response (format=json) includes: export_schema_version (e.g., "1.0"), generated_at, tenant_id, tier, region_scope, effective_policy (data_class -> ttl_days, purge_semantics, legal_hold_supported flag), defaults_applied (per class), constraints (min/max per tier), and history_summary (bounded list with event_id, occurred_at, actor_type, action, affected_classes, previous_hash, new_hash). Example snippet: { "export_schema_version": "1.0", "generated_at": "2025-02-14T19:22:10Z", "tenant_id": "tnt_1g8...", "tier": "Dedicated", "effective_policy": { "audit_logs": { "ttl_days": 365, "purge_semantics": "hard_delete" }, "request_response_logs": { "ttl_days": 30, "purge_semantics": "hard_delete" } }, "history_summary": [ { "event_id": 4812, "occurred_at": "2025-02-14T18:01:00Z", "actor_type": "user", "action": "update", "affected_classes": "audit_logs", "previous_hash": "rp_7f9...", "new_hash": "rp_8a1..." } ] } Notes/decisions: - We store both a normalized policy hash and a small diff summary (affected data classes + ttl deltas) so audits can see what changed without reconstructing the full prior policy from logs. - History_summary is bounded to prevent accidental large exports; default window_days=90 with max=365. Full history export is intentionally deferred (non-goal) until we validate customer needs + storage costs. - This is designed to integrate with ENG-18441 (report generator) and audit-log-exporter PR-627 (attachment bundling). Rollout: Behind feature flag retention_exports_v1 for 1 week; enabled for internal tenants + 2 design partners; then GA. DB migration is safe and backward compatible. No changes to existing retention CRUD endpoints besides writing change events. Risks/mitigations: - PII leakage in change events: actor is stored as IDs; display name is resolved at export time via directory service, and can be disabled in Private deployments. - DB growth: events are small; we will apply a long TTL (7y) only for Dedicated/Private tenants by default, else 1y for Hosted (configurable later). - Consistency: policy write and change event write are in one transaction; export reads at REPEATABLE READ to avoid mismatched policy/hash. Screenshots: none (API-only).
commits: control-plane/retention: write change events on policy create/update
control-plane/retention: add export endpoint + schema versioning (v1.0)
authz: add RETENTION_EXPORT_READ permission + role bindings
tests: export snapshots, RBAC integration tests, ETag tests
docs(internal): add endpoint notes + example payload
review_conversation: Marcus Lin (Security): Please confirm export payload doesn’t include prompt/completion contents or request bodies. Also, ensure audit event doesn’t log the export body.

Kevin Osei (author): Confirmed. Export only includes retention config + bounded history summary; no request bodies. Audit event is metadata-only (tenant_id, actor_id, schema version, request_id). Added a test asserting audit payload keys.
Olga Petrov (GRC): Can we make the schema version explicit and stable for customer evidence, and include a generated_at timestamp + window_days used? This will help with audit trails.
Kevin Osei (author): Done. Added export_schema_version="1.0", generated_at, and echo of window_days/include params in the top-level response. Snapshot updated.

Jordan Lee (Platform): ETag composition worries me—if history_summary is requested, latest_change_event_id is fine, but if include=none, you can skip history. Also please document max window_days and behavior when there are >N events.

Kevin Osei (author): Updated ETag to incorporate include + window_days and to conditionally use latest_change_event_id only when history_summary is included. Added docs + enforced max window_days=365 and hard cap of 500 events in summary with a truncated=true flag (string field) in response.
Chloe Martin (Console): For future console download, can we keep the endpoint path consistent with other tenant exports? Also add OpenAPI annotations for the new route.
Kevin Osei (author): Kept it under /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/retention/export and added OpenAPI schema + examples; console can call this directly once wired.
Ethan Park (Approver): Looks good. Please add transaction note in code comment and ensure backfill seed event uses system actor type. After that, approve.
Kevin Osei (author): Added comment on transactional write + set actor_type=system for backfill seed. Pushed fixup commit.
Marcus Lin: Approved after latest changes.
